title: Seat-Scale Discount for ClearPath Clients on Professional Services Projects
content:
On a Professional Services Projects time-and-materials statement of work, the seat-scale component of the rate discount locked at signature follows the number of seats the client's active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement covers on the signature date.

The seat-scale component of the rate discount locked at signature is 1.0 percentage point for a client whose active ClearPath agreement covers 100 or more seats, 0.5 percentage point for one covering 50 to 99 seats, and nothing for any other client.

| Seats covered by the active ClearPath agreement | Seat-scale component |
|---|---|
| 100 or more | 1.0 |
| 50 to 99 | 0.5 |
| fewer than 50 | nothing |
| no active ClearPath agreement | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical seat counts)

| Seats | Component |
|---|---|
| 49 | nothing |
| 50 | 0.5 |
| 99 | 0.5 |
| 100 | 1.0 |
